heard: From the tribe of Zebulun stood a man Gadiel's son or so he was his name Moses sent him from the wilderness of Paran To scout the land as the Lord did command He walked through the Negev up to Hebron Saw the giants there, the strong and the seven They cut a cluster in the valley of Eshcol And carried it on a pole for the whole 40 days they wandered out And came back to show
